system.description:
Effect

You gain +10 bonus to negotiation and intimidation checks, but automatically fail any stealth checks.

Effect

After using the Block action, you may spend 0 RP to cast off the armor immediately unequipping it. The armor becomes Broken until repaired.

Effect

This armor looks like normal clothing to other creatures (which may make you look more vulnerable than you are).

Effect

Requires Manaweave Frame mod. While wearing this armor you gain presence concealment. Spending any mana immediately removes presence concealment. After losing presence concealment, you can’t regain it until you rest for the day.

Effect

This armor provides no passive guard bonus, but reduces the Initiative penalty by 2 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 4. When taking the Block action, you still receive the normal bonus the armor would provide.This armor provides no passive guard bonus, but reduces the Initiative penalty by 2 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 4. When taking the Block action, you still receive the normal bonus the armor would provide.

Effect

Reduces the Initiative penalty by 1 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 2, but only gives the passive guard increase. When taking the Block action, it does not gain an increased guard (though any other bonuses to your Block such as your Toughness still apply).

Effect

Reduces the Initiative penalty by 1 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 2. but reduces the wearer's current and maximum mana by 3 when equipped. Cannot be equipped if it would reduce the mana below 0.

Effect

Requires Manaweave Frame mod. While putting on this armor, your mana is set to 0. For each max mana you lose thanks to this effect, you gain 7 temporary HP. When you would regain mana or HP from resting, this temporary HP regenerates (up to a max of what you started with at the start of the arc)

Effect

This armor boosts the range of Mind Connection and Scry by 10x. Also reduces the mana cost of Psychometry by 1.

Effect

Reduces the Initiative penalty by 1 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 2, but you take double damage from Water damage.

Effect

You become immune to Burning and natural heat effects.

Effect

All creatures ending their turn next to you take Light Fire damage.

Effect

Reduces the Initiative penalty by 1 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 2, but the bonuses of this armor only apply against ranged attacks.

Effect

After you Dodge, you gain +10ft of movement speed until the end of your next turn.

Effect

When you would take falling or pushback damage, you treat the distance you would fall as 30ft lower.

Effect

You may Hover.

Effect

Reduces the Initiative penalty by 1 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 2, but you take double damage from Earth damage.

Effect

Anyone ending their turn next to you is afflicted with Static 12 that triggers at the end of their next turn.

Effect

Any attack dealing Lightning damage that targets an ally within 30ft of you and doesn’t include you as a target suffers a -5 penalty to Accuracy.

Effect

he first time each round you take damage from a Heavy attack in melee, you may make a Light attack against the attacker.

Effect

Reduces the Initiative penalty by 1 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 2 during the night.

Effect

You gain +5 stealth during the night (doesn’t stack with cloak).

Effect

Reduces the Initiative penalty by 1 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 2, but you take double damage from Lightning damage and you are considered permanently soaked.

Effect

You gain a swim speed of 20ft and can hold your breath for twice as long.

Effect

You may walk on water as if it was normal ground.

Effect

You gain a +4 bonus to your Dodge.

Effect

Enemies within 5ft of you are slowed. This slow is applied during a movement if they walk within 5ft of you. Lasts until they are no longer within 5ft of you, but it applies for the entire movement if leaving the range.

Effect

Reduces the Initiative penalty by 1 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 2, but you take double damage from Fire damage.

Effect

You gain 20ft of Tremorsense.

Effect

You gain a +8 bonus to your Block.

Effect

You radiate a bright light that illuminates up to 60ft away.

Effect

Undead creatures that deal damage to you take Light Holy damage in return.

Effect

Your movement speed increases by 5ft while flying.

Effect

You may spend 1 RP to glide (as per the aeromancer ability)

Effect

When you drop to 0 or lower HP, you may immediately revive at 1 HP. You still gain an injury.

Effect

When you push or pull a target, you may push or pull them for an additional 5ft.

Effect

You gain a +4 bonus to your evasion against ranged attacks, but you cannot make any ranged attacks yourself (they automatically miss).

Effect

You can move through natural difficult terrain without losing movement.

Effect

When you take the Block action against an enemy attack, you heal for 3 HP.

Effect

Your astra corruption resistance is increased by 1.

Effect

You gain a +1 to initiative for every allied creature (including yourself) wearing an armor with this mod (max +3).

Effect

The first time each combat you take damage from an attack, the attacker becomes Dazed as bees attack it.

Effect

The first time each combat you take damage from a melee attack, you release a swarm of insects in a 5ft radius around you. The swarm remains in the same spot and any creature other than you ending its turn inside of it takes 6 full pierce damage.

Effect

When you are downed, attacks against you do not gain Full Pierce as your armor actively protects you.

Effect

While you are downed, a necromantic hand activates on your armor, performing emergency medical aid, you regain 2 HP per turn.

Effect

Critical hits against you do not gain Full Pierce (but still do max damage)

Effect

You automatically escape from the first grapple effect against you each encounter.

Effect

You gain Spider Climb while wearing this armor (as per spiderfolk racial).

Effect

You may apply a poison to this armor as a Rest action. When you are hit by a melee attack, the poison explodes outwards and automatically triggers on the attacker as if you had dealt damage to them.

Effect

You gain 5 DR against Poison damage.

Effect

This weapon is treated as a weapon that can be used for Ninjutsu.

Effect

You may draw this weapon for 0 AP.

Effect

This weapon gives a +1 bonus to gathering rolls its used in.

Effect

When using the weapon in dual wielding, you can perform a dual wield attack with your other weapon, even when making a heavy attack with this weapon.

Effect

The weapon is designed to look like a mundane object. Each Combat, after you draw the weapon, if the next attack you make that round is using this weapon and is a basic light or heavy attack it gains the Trick Attack keyword. After benefitting from this bonus, you cannot do so again the same combat even if drawing a different weapon with with Surprise Weapon or Hidden Weapon.

Effect

Can be added to a One-Handed weapon from a group that also has an option to be a Two-Handed weapon (ie Axe, but not small weapons). Increases the burden of the weapon by 1, but the weapon can be used as either a one-handed or two-handed weapon. Must declare which version you are using at the start of your turn, before you making any attacks with this weapon.

Effect

An accuracy roll of 20 gains Sure Hit. If you roll a 20 and choose to have this apply, any Full Pierce is removed from the attack.
